purpose: Check whether evidence can be reused across Mumbai corridors grouped by display color, while retaining separate corridor and station identities.

auditSummary.yellow: Sources now cover both Line 2A and Line 2B. They can fill corridor-level topology, proposed station design, selected official operational status, and family-level station standards. They do not yet close full Line 2B CTM/GIS or station-specific as-built infrastructure.
auditSummary.red: Sources now cover Line 7 plus the combined Line 7A/9 extension project and current operator phases. They establish Red-family topology and current Line 9 operational GIS points. They do not establish all-station as-built platform/transfer facts or provide Line 7A operational data while it remains under construction.
auditSummary.colorGroupingRule: Use MUMBAI_YELLOW or MUMBAI_RED to find shared sources and display styling; retain each MUMBAI_LINE* system code as the evidence subject and preserve its own station IDs, status, and topology.

findings: MMRDA identifies both 2A and 2B as Yellow. Line 2A is an operational 17-station CTM line; Line 2B is a separate partially operational corridor.

The Line 2B DPR (2016) is now acquired locally and contains proposed station sequence/design and system facts. It gives a 22-station design count. MMRDA's current overview names 20 route stations but its feature table says 19; ArcGIS Yellow feature 54 also reports 22. Preserve the conflict; use the current operator station-name list for the current 20-name route until MMRDA clarifies the count.

As of 31 August 2026 MMRDA reports five Line 2B stations operational from 7 April and Chembur from 13 August (six total). ArcGIS feature points are source-verified for Chembur, Shivaji Chowk, BSNL Metro, Mankhurd, and Mandale. Diamond Park Metro Station is only a candidate crosswalk for MMRDA's Diamond Garden name and remains unpromoted.

MMMOCL's 2025 station tender provides family-level typical station information: road/concourse/platform levels, usually two platforms, paid/unpaid areas, security-before-AFC arrangement, circulation equipment, and half-height/full-height PSD use. These are generic standards, not station-by-station as-built facts.
The 2026 retail/kiosk station-plan tender lists Lines 2A, 7, and 9 annexures, but no Line 2B drawing. Its plans are a layout lead and are not automatically certified as-built engineering drawings.
stillOpen: Complete current station-name-to-ArcGIS crosswalk for all 20 Line 2B stations, especially Diamond Garden/Diamond Park and stations whose public names are shortened or renamed in GIS.
Validated Line 2B route shape/KML and complete station-coordinate set before CTM promotion.
Line 2B current platform numbers/directions and station-specific as-built levels, circulation, PSD installation/type, and accessible path.
Current Line 2A/2B AFC interoperability and exact passenger-transfer rules at D.N. Nagar. The old DPR proposes interoperable smart-card products; it does not prove the present rule.

findings: Line 7 remains an operational 14-station CTM corridor with 419 alignment vertices and 96.9% supplied-KML coverage. The 2015 DPR's 16 proposed stations are design-era records and should not replace its current CTM station set.

MMRDA's combined Red extension project comprises eight Line 9 stations plus two Line 7A airport stations. Line 9's current first phase has four operational stations from Dahisar East to Kashigaon as of 7 April 2026; Line 7A remains under construction in MMRDA's 31 August 2026 update.

Official ArcGIS features 996, 1094, 981, and 982 provide source-verified point coordinates for the four current Line 9 phase-I stations. These replace the three community/OSM bootstrap coordinates; Dahisar reuses the shared L2A/L7 location and must not create a duplicate physical interchange point.

ArcGIS Red route features identify 14 Line 7 stations and 8 Line 9 stations. The combined 7A/9 DPR provides proposed design evidence for both branches. Do not treat the project-total 10 stations as the count for Line 9 alone.

The 2026 kiosk/layout tender lists Line 7 and Line 9 plans but no 7A plan. The plans may improve layout evidence but do not by themselves prove passenger directions, AFC boundaries, transfer paths, or as-built status.
stillOpen: Line 9 canonical CTM station entities and full crosswalk to the official ArcGIS route/points; only the four operational phase-I points are source-verified here.
Line 7A operational station IDs, passenger wayfinding, commissioning status, and station-specific as-built details; it remains under construction.
Current platform numbering/directions, station-specific as-built floor labels and screen-door type/status across Lines 7 and 9.
Dahisar transfer distance/time, paid-area continuity/AFC retap rules, security path, and end-to-end step-free route.
Current Andheri East/Gundavali–Airport Colony transfer layout and operating instructions for Line 7A; the shared Red color and 2017 DPR are not sufficient to assert passenger-transfer semantics.

familyWideStandardsLimits: The 2025 MMMOCL source can populate only a generic operator-design-standard layer for the named lines (and upcoming lines). It must not be copied as station-specific installed equipment or exact levels.

A DPR can populate proposed design evidence for the corridor it covers; it cannot resolve current station names, operational platform numbering/direction, or as-built interchange fare/security pathways by color-family inheritance.
Color is a display/source-discovery grouping, not a substitute for corridor identity or evidence applicability.
